articleTitle: Assurance of electromagnetic compatibility of group frequency controlled electro drives with power supply sources
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Experience of creation and implementation of gas cooler with the frequency-regulated electro drive of fans shows a necessity of measures to the assurance of electromagnetic compatibility of the frequency-regulated electro drives with a power supply sources. On certain quantity of concurrently running gas coolers with frequency-regulated electro drive of fans the significant distortion of voltage curve form occurs in grid. The problem becomes more serious in case of autonomous power supply sources. The ways of problem solving of assurance of electromagnetic compatibility of the frequency controlled electro drives with a power supply sources introduced in this paper. Described results reached by mathematical modeling MATLAB+Simulink.

articleTitle: Voltage stabilization on the power supply system based on the synchronous generator with variable rotor speed
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The existing systems of electric power generation are most commonly based on synchronous electric machines which have to operate with a fixed shaft rotation frequency for the purpose of providing the stability of output current frequency. The development of power electronics has made it possible to create the systems of electric power generation, in which the frequency of shaft rotation may vary in order to optimize the regime of drive motor operation. The article describes the structural scheme of such a system and demonstrates the specific features of implementing its elements.

articleTitle: The analysis of the DC-DC converters photovoltaic power supply systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the influence of temperature and illumination on the current-voltage and voltage-watt solar battery characteristics. Developed a method of determining the main parameters of solar cells based on the current temperature and illumination. The basic types of DC-DC converters photovoltaic power supply systems explored.

articleTitle: Wavelet filtering in digital signal processing systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Under review is features of specialized filters using, based on discrete wavelet transform what applied in electronic systems. It is shown that using of such filters reduces the computational complexity in digital filtration systems.

articleTitle: Application of wavelet analysis to determine the parameters of the normal distribution law
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the method of determining the parameters of the normal distribution law on track section of the wavelet-spectrum in scale a=1, obtained by the continuous wavelet transform using wavelets Gauss second order. The standard deviation of the distribution is as taking the logarithm of the selected section.

articleTitle: Improvement schemes elements of measuring instruments used for monitoring buildings

articleTitle: Reliability improving of test monitoring of complex digital electronic devices
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In design and development of a monitoring system for digital electronic devices one of the main problems is the synthesis of test pseudorandom sequences (PS) with required features. The analytical estimators of correcting capacity of test PS based on their statistical features are derived in the paper. The results obtained allow one to rise drastically the efficiency and reliability of diagnostic procedures of complex digital devices.

articleTitle: The logical design process automation control systems

articleTitle: Optical spectroscory of isoquinoline-1-carboxylate europium with sodium in various solvents
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)

articleTitle: The temperature sensors operation in the low-intensity radiation fields
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This theses deals with the experimental study results of the low-intensity ionizing radiation influence on the temperature sensors DS18B20 measurement error at the absorbed doses in the range 0–400 Gy under gamma radiation with a dose rate 4.10 Gy/s. The measurement error was determined by the difference between the temperature values of irradiated sensors and non-irradiated control sensor. It was found that temperature measurement errors corresponding to the temperature sensors working range limit values are characterized by a larger spread in values for various sensors and nonmonotone measurement error dependence on the absorbed dose.

articleTitle: Thermal resistance of the helical slow-wave system made by a method of solid-phase compound of ceramic-metal elements

articleTitle: High-precision software programmable pulsed stabilizator of direct current

articleTitle: Design concept of field emission cathode for microwave vacuum device with ionic protection of nanosized blade emitter

articleTitle: A method for detecting of voltage distributionamong vacuum interrupters in circuit breaker

It was shown that voltage distribution is dependent on the type and value of breaker output load. The method in question is shown to be instrumental for evaluation of the shunt capacitors used to achieve a more even voltage distribution among vacuum interrupters in series.

articleTitle: Synthesis of microwave and microcontroller equipment for particle size measurement
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper discusses problems of particle size measurement on the basis of utilizing microwave and microcontroller equipment. Results of theoretical studies of reflectance properties of dielectric particles and current-conducting ones during electromagnetic-wave sounding of them are presented. Experimental results of particle diameter measurement in relation to electromagnetic oscillation frequency and incidence angle and acceptance one for reflected signals are demonstrated. The feasibility of using an information signal received during the acceptance of a reflected orthogonal-polarization signal is shown. A configuration scheme for microcontroller facilities for particle signal processing is proposed. Recommended practices for designing equipment for particle size measurement are given.

articleTitle: A comparison of basic 94 GHz planar transmission line resonators in commercial BiCMOS back-end-of-line processes
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A comparative simulation study of planar 94 GHz resonators in a typical BiCMOS BEOL stack-up is presented, with the effect of chip passivation included. It is shown that Q-factors of between 3 and 15 can be obtained, depending on transmission medium and ground plane layer choice. Straight half-wavelength and shorted quarter-wavelength microstrip resonators are shown to outperform CPW, GCPW and hairpin resonators, with highest Q-factors obtained where the lowest available metallization layer is used as ground plane. Q-factors of above 10 may also be achieve in the absence of any ground plane in CPW, which may be implemented in processes (such as GaAs or GaN) where multiple metallization layers are not readily available.

publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper discusses the development of a cost-effective, universal PCB test platform aimed to minimise test time and expand test coverage. The platform provides the efficient and effective testing of PCBs at the functional level. In contrast to existing functional testing equipment designed for one particular PCB only, the proposed platform is universal and can be easily reconfigured and reprogrammed to test different PCBs. A prototype of the test platform was developed and built using National Instrument hardware and software.

articleTitle: Ridged waveguide as a device for measuring the dielectric permittivity of materials
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article discusses the concept of a device for measuring the permittivity of dielectric materials. This device is a single-ridged waveguide. Measurements are supposed to be carried out by the transmission of electromagnetic waves and assessment of the distribution characteristics.

articleTitle: An on-chip post-production tunable group delay equaliser
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A design method for distributed element on-chip post-production tunable group delay equalising networks is presented. It is shown that a number of adjustable Darlington C-sections can be used to equalise the group delay of an arbitrary network. The C-sections are implemented in an IBM 0.13 μm BiCMOS process as complementary microstrip slotline-stub all-pass structures and modified to provide post-production tunability. The group delay ripple of a theoretical second-order Butterworth bandpass filter, cascaded with the synthesised all-pass network, is reduced by 43% as proof of concept.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of the static reactive power compensator
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The STATCOM type static reactive power compensator is a high-speed self-commutated voltage invertor (SCVI) with storage capacitor C in the DC-unit connected to the AC-network via three-phase self-inductor L. STATCOM's functional chart is shown in Fig. 1, a [1]. It realizes the principle of the direct balancing. It is a compensator of a transverse type; it is connected in-parallel to the load which reactive power is to be compensated. This compensator can generate capacitive and inductive reactive power.

articleTitle: The dual-mode double-gap resonator with asymmetrrical strip line on the suspended ceramic substrate
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A new dual-mode double-gap resonator on the basis of asymmetrical suspended stripline for miniature klystron type microwave tubes with field emitter arrays (FEA) cathodes was investigated. The resonator has a smaller size and mass when a doublegap capacitive segment of each quasi-lumped resonator consists of two assimmetrical strip conductors on opposite sides of the substrate and both inductive segments are grounded. This resonance circuit has two oscillation modes (anti-phase and in-phase). On the basis of the 3-D modeling found that such oscillatory systems can achieve the excitation of these modes with multiplicity of frequencies to = 2 with a good efficiency of interaction of electrons with microwave fields.

articleTitle: An L-band tapered-ridge SIW-to-CPW transition
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A tapered ridge transition between coplanar waveguide and substrate-integrated waveguide is presented. The taper is implemented through staircase metallization across 10 layers of conventional RF substrate with sidewall expansion and upper cut-out using Vivaldi-type exponential tapers. Fractional bandwidth of 36% is achieved in the L-band, with insertion loss of 0.5 dB and return loss of 15 dB.

articleTitle: Calculation of measurement uncertainties of multi-port transmission line reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article describes the benefits of using the method for evaluation of uncertainties of errors arising during the operation and calibration of multi-port transmission line reflectometer. The expressions for measurement uncertainties caused by different sources are given.

articleTitle: The magnetron 3 kW at a frequency of 915 MHz for promising systems of heating
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of development and research magnetron designed for microwave heating, which has an output power of 3 kW, continuous operation and the anode voltage of 4.5 kV. Overall efficiency of the magnetron is not less than 80% at a magnetic field of 140–160 mT.

articleTitle: Small-sized decoupling microwave filter on the metamaterial investigation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The investigation of small-sized decoupling microwave filter on the metamaterial are considered. The results of numerical simulation filter using AWR Design Environment (Microwave Office v.9.0) and studies of experimental model on the basis of the vector analyzer ZVB-4 is shown.

articleTitle: Magnetic and electric fields of industrial frequency at a distance from overhea power lines
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Analytical mathematical models for magnetic and electric fields of a three-phase air transmission lines which allows to calculate the field strength at a large distance from the line were developed. We calculated values of the field strength for high-voltage lines, justifying the possibility of detecting air lines by aircrafts during low-altitude.

articleTitle: Phase locking of a gyrotron in the hard excitation mode
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In the theory of self-oscillating systems usually one distinguish two different kinds of self-excitation, namely soft and hard excitation. In the hard excitation mode a self-oscillation is sustained only for a sufficiently intensive initial perturbation, which amplitude exceeds a certain threshold, while a small perturbation decays. The phenomenon of hard excitation is natural for many electronic oscillators. In particular, in a gyrotron a maximal efficiency is often attained in the hard excitation regime. In recent years, the problem of phase locking of a gyrotron by an external driving signal has attracted a significant interest. This work is aimed on study of injection-locked operation of two models of a gyrotron in the hard excitation mode.

articleTitle: Circuit and connection design of microwave differential difference amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The architecture and circuit design of microwave differential difference amplifier (DDA) are considered. The basic equations that simplify the calculation of the parameters of analog devices based on DDA are given. The properties of the basic connection circuits of DDA taking into account the loop gain are considered. The transmission coefficients and the input resistances of these circuits at identical and non-identical conductivities of input voltage — current converters and different feedback resistances are defined. Single DDA allows without feedback resistors to provide a high input impedance and wide range of identical characteristics for inverting and noninverting connections, as well as different transmission coefficients are shown. The simulation results of inverting and noninverting amplifiers based on the microwave DDA with operating at frequency range 5–15 GHz are given.

articleTitle: Application of frequency-dependent absorber and diminishing phase velocity under it to improve parameters of ultra broadband TWT
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method of broadening the operation frequency range to the long-wave edge of powerful broadband helix TWT is suggested. It consists in the use of frequency-dependent absorbers. And, the absorber attenuation is significantly less at the lower frequency than at the upper one. Computations for ultra broadband TWT are carried out. It is shown, that due to this method an electronic efficiency at lower frequencies is increased, and the level of the second harmonics is decreased. Further improvements of the parameters can be achieved by decreasing helix pitch under the absorber.

articleTitle: Characteristics of electron beam in TWT with higt microperveance
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The numerical and experimental study of electron beam in TWT with higt microperveance and quasi-hollow forms is fulfilled. The results of the numerical study of electron beam structure correspond to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Radiofrequency identification system based on surface acoustic waves for novel frequency range 6 GHz
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Theoretically and experimentally radiofrequency identification system on surface acoustic waves in the 6 GHz band was studied. The SAW tag calculations take into account the finite thickness of the electrodes, difference the acoustic properties of a thin film of aluminum, bulk scattering and energy dissipation of SAW during reflection from the electrodes. Calculated test tag was made using electron beam lithography. The losses of code pulses of 50–55 dB were received. Moreover, the results of theoretical modeling of integral antenna were discussed and optimal antenna's parameters matched with SAW interdigital transducer were given.

articleTitle: Resonant diocotron instability non relativistic electron flow in a magnetron diode with a non uniform magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Weak resonant diocotron instability non relativistic electron flow in a cylindrical magnetron diode with applied non uniform magnetic field is investigated within the framework of the hydrodynamic theory. Increments of frequency for high electrons concentration and azimuthally low-frequency perturbations are given.

articleTitle: Particular demands to magnet parameters of focusing systems for multibeam TWT and klystrons
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Particular demands to magnet parameters of focusing systems for multi-beams TWT and klystrons are discussed. Restrictions on the homogeneity of the magnetic field is offered. Opportunities to improve the homogeneity of the magnetic field in the working volume is offered.

articleTitle: The stop bands of coupled cavities chains with periodic discontinuities
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of the study of coupled cavities chains with periodic discontinuities taking into account changes the spectral composition of the field harmonics are presented. Investigated individual bandpass components and stop bands between them in a inhomogeneous system. The connection the values of the bandpass components displacement and stop bands width between them with the type, size and number of discontinuities is established.

articleTitle: Comparison of characteristics of a double-mode sector resonators multibeam devices of the klystron type
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Results of numerical 3D — modeling of a new type of double-mode multibeam klystron resonators with the sector shape of the cavity are presented. Assess the efficiency of quarter-wave and half-wave designs sector double-gap resonators when setting both the mode of interaction of the electrons with the microwave field at multiple resonant frequencies corresponding to the fundamental frequency of the anti-phase oscillation mode (2450 MHz) and twice the in-phase frequency (4900 MHz).

articleTitle: Research about the conditions of parametric generation in planar resonators
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This report summarizes the results obtained in the papers relating to the generation of high-frequency signal in crossed electric and magnetic fields in a planar state. Authors have shown the behavior of electron cloud in next-gen planar generator. Estimated devices output characteristics based on the principles specified in this report were determined.

articleTitle: Inverstigation of multi-beam K-range monotron with three-gap cavity
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The K-band three-cavity multi-beam transit-time effect oscillator (3K MTTTO) is a novel high power microwave device based on the transit-time effect of the three-cavity (3C) resonator. Electronic and electrodynamic parameters of 3C resonator were calculated. The ranges of accelerating voltages were founded at which self-excitation of monotron possibly.

articleTitle: Investigation of processes in the retarding field oscillator with the virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this work an oscillator with the hot cathode executed on the basis of the two-gap resonator is investigated. The structure of the retarding field oscillator differs from the classical reflective klystron that the reflector is entered into interaction space of the resonator. It was experimentally confirmed that in the modified retarding field oscillator with the two-gap resonator excited at multiple resonant frequencies, the electronic efficiency can reach 30% that approximately in 10 times more, than in a usual reflective klystron.

articleTitle: Sources of power coherent terahertz band radiation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Main properties of terahertz electromagnetic waves and importance of its application in various radar and communication systems are considered. Klystrons as one of most perspective types of power sources are examined and its ability to work in terahertz band is discussed. Examples of millimeter and submillimeter bands klystrons are described.

articleTitle: Current state and prospects of development the micromachined electrovacuum devices in the short-range microwave
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this article prospects of creations of new miniature electro vacuum amplifiers and generators of the terahertz range on the basis of vacuum integrated schemes with a field emission cathodes are considered. Analogs of such devices are classical devices of vacuum electronics with average transit angle: monotrons, reflex klystrons, klystrons with the distributed interaction. The ways to further increase efficiency and power output of such devices were defined.

articleTitle: Induction of cylinder film with azimuth density of vortex current
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method of calculation of inserted inductance of conducting cylindrical film by arbitrary geometry size with azimuth density of vortex current under existence of resistance loss and diamagnetic properties of Foucault currents has been proposed. The formula for frequency dependence has been adduced. It is followed from this formula that the inductance of cylindrical film comes to zero for two characteristic frequencies of the system and can has positive and negative values. Is has been shown that RPGS — inductors belong to the class of inductors with inserted inductance. The solution of cutoff frequency's problem of strip MEMS — solenoids by insertion of micron size nichrome film has been proposed.

articleTitle: Phasestability TWT
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: We discusses the possibility of reducing the modulation noise amplifiers of superhigh frequency (UHF) for traveling wave tubes (TWT) by applying in TWT sections of asynchronous interaction. We analyzed are the amplitude and phase characteristics in different modes of operation, design of the interaction space TWT, possible ways to build amplifiers.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of magnetostatic backward volume waves excited by the narrow transducer
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of experimental investigation of diffraction profiles of magnetostatic backward volume waves (MSBVW) exited by the linear transducer with finite length located at the surface of ferrite-dielectric structure are presented. The comparison of experimental data obtained and theoretical calculations is reported.

articleTitle: A three-layer model of power electronic management of multi-bus vehicle electrical system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Power electronic management described in this paper aims to save energy in vehicle electrical system on a bus level by applying an economic framework for treating energy as a priced commodity. By treating energy as a commodity, it is possible to establish cost effective and optimal buffering behaviour as well as minimum cost energy routing. The system has been implemented and verified using Matlab/Simulink. The total verification model of the management system is divided into three layers: vehicle model layer, management system model layer, and abstraction model layer containing the various mathematical models used by the management system to obtain optimal solutions.

articleTitle: Generation and control of wide-range microwave chaotic signals TWT-generator
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of experimental research on the generation of wide-range microwave chaos based on TWT-generator. Researched and detected a chaotic signal absolute suppression mode external harmonic input of a certain frequency and power. This effect allows for impulse modulation of the input signal to provide the generation of chaotic microwave radio pulses.

articleTitle: Cascade klystron generator of chaotic UHF wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents results of experimental research of microwave chaos generation by cascade klystron generator. To increase chaotic band two klystrons were mechanically tuned for partial cavities frequencies overlap and connected in parallel. Researched chaotic mode suppression by external harmonic signal of certain frequency and power. This effect allows generation of chaotic microwave radio pulses by impulse modulation of the input signal.

articleTitle: Hybrid camera of the beam type microwave elektroteh-nological installations
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The brought method of increasing to energy efficiency of the cameras of the beam type is offered different arrangement of the hybrid cameras of the beam type microwave electrotehnological of the installation.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of modeling microwave and terahertz frequency selective structures
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Frequency selective surfaces (FSS) find wide practical application in modern microwave and terahertz engineering as basic units of filters, absorbers, polarizers and etc. Some peculiarities of such metasurfaces modeling are considered in present study. Results of numerical simulations for mesh polarizers and pass-band filters on FSS are represented.

articleTitle: Analytical relations for calculation of basic operational characteristics of new construction shortwave magnetron
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A modification of magnetron with a larger area of the cathode proposed. The Approximate analytical model of short-wave magnetron develop. It is shown that the proposed modification can increase the output power of the magnetron cathode and to facilitate cooling, which is particularly important in the millimeter-wave magnetrons and short-wave end of centimeter-wave magnetrons.

articleTitle: The theoretical and experimental research of diffraction efficiency acousto-optic Bragg cells employing traveling wave phase array transducers
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental research of diffraction efficiency Bragg cells with traveling wave multielectrode transducers are presented. The equation for theoretical calculating diffraction efficiency of such acousto-optic Bragg cell is obtained. The nonlinear character of diffraction efficiency as a function of elementary transducers quantity is shown.

articleTitle: The electron-optical systems with a sheet electron beam of THz band TWT with increased uniformity of magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of computer analysis of the sheet electron beams in a uniform and reverse magnetic field for low perveance electron-optical system based on thermionic cathode with a current density of 100 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with a total length of 60–65 mm. Experimental studies in diode mode of dispenser thermionic cathode with dimensions of 0,1·0,7 mm are conducted and the feasibility of using one in vacuum microwave amplifiers of terahertz electronics is shown.

articleTitle: Calculation grouping of electrons of generating-amplifying klystrons with application of nonlinear coefficient of the reduction of the field of the space charge
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The ratios presenting one-dimensional electron motion in the grouping electron current in drift tubes of a generating-amplifying klystron, allowing for operation of forces of a space charge are received.

articleTitle: Effect of reflections on dynamics of simple modeles of a multimode gyrotron
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Effect of delayed reflection from the remote load on mode competition in two- and three-mode models of a gyrotron is considered. A system of quasi-linear delay-differential equations for slowly varying amplitudes of the modes is derived. Transitions between different generation regimes with increasing of reflection of the spurious modes are investigated analytically and numerically at different values of delay.

articleTitle: Designing transmission lines EHF range with the end conductor on the substrate for hybrid integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In a rigorous formulation of electrostatic solved the problem of synthesis of the transmission line (TL) with end conductor having a number of advantages in comparison with microstrip and slotted TL. The basic design relations are obtained. Shown the results of computer simulation of the proposed TL.

articleTitle: Investigation of influence of different parameters on results of probe oxidation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Fabrication of nanosized lines on magnetic films is of special interest because such lines can be used as nanosized elements for fabrication of planar tunnel junctions [1] or periodic planar structures that can serve as surface phononic crystal (SPC) for hypersonic frequency range that could be controlled by magnetic field [2]. Probe oxidation is one of the perspective tools to create such nanostructures. It is based on the electrochemical reaction of oxidation in the water meniscus under the sharp tip of the atomic force microscope (AFM). The reaction is stimulated by applied voltage between the tip and the sample [3]. There are only few works on probe oxidation of Ni [1, 4-5] and FeCo films [5]. But there is no investigation on influence of wide range of parameters on oxidation results. In this work investigation of dependences of probe oxidation of ferromagnetic metal films Ni and FeCo on different probe oxidation parameters is presented. Definition of optimal process parameters for fabrication structures with certain sizes was done.

articleTitle: Raising the saturated efficiency of the TWT by optimization the electrode configuration with zero potential
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of calculation of five stage depressed collector of helix C-band TWT for space communications are described. Also was made the optimization of construction reflector with zero potential for raising of saturated efficiency.

articleTitle: Output two-gap cavity for multibeam klysrode with biharmonic field
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article describes the results of two-gap cavity simulation tuned to multiple frequencies equal to three. Such a cavity can increase energy extraction uniformity of RF voltage due to the shape nearly rectangular.

articleTitle: A model of couplded spin torque nano-oscillators with broadband synchronization
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Broadband synchronization of two coupled spin torque nano-oscillators is reported. The frequency detuning is controlled by the spin current densities, the coupling is introduced via magnetic fields generated by the oscillators, and the coupling strength corresponds to their distance. The fields are computed in a simplified form based on a dipole approximation. The synchronization is observed up to tenfold difference in natural frequencies of the oscillators when the coupling strength remains moderately small.

articleTitle: Scattering of magnetostatic waves by defects of the surface of a ferromagnetic film
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The solution for the diffraction problem of scattering of magnetostatic waves by an arbitrary shallow defect situated under the surface of a ferromagnetic film magnetized at an arbitrary angle is obtained in the quasi-static approximation. Expressions for the energy flux density of scattered magnetostatic waves in the far-field zone are found.

articleTitle: Power tetrode spice model
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The report covers some important issues related to the creation of a power tetrode SPICE model including the requirements necessary for model realization in SPICE simulators. The problem of model fidelity has been discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of microstrip filters based on the multimode resonator having strip conductor in the shape of a ring
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Microstrip band-pass filters based on the multimode resonator, having conductors in the shape of a rectangular ring are investigated. Such devices because of the high steepness of slopes of a passband and an extended high-frequency stopband can have high frequency selective properties.

articleTitle: The analysis obtaining of optical image acoustic object by hybrid acousto-optic Fourier processor
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The Bragg-diffraction-based method of visualization of in-plane distributions of heterogeneous acoustic fields with the use of two-stage Fourier transformation is considered. In comparison with the popular Corpel technique of Bragg visualization the proposed method is free of the astigmatism. The equations for calculating optic image of acoustical object are given.

articleTitle: Selective amplifier microwave-based non-inverting repeater AC current element basis of radiation resistant SiGe process technology
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Considered circuitry of selective amplifiers (SA) of the microwave range, the basis for constructing non-inverting repeaters alternating current. Proposed scheme of SA implemented in element basis of radiation-resistant SiGe process technology and don't contain any of the PNP transistors. Given calculation expressions of basic parameters. Shown the results of computer simulation of the SA in the gigahertz frequency range.

articleTitle: GaAs low-barrier diode
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This work considers the GaAs low-barrier diode characteristics. A comparative analysis of theoretical and experimental current-voltage characteristics a low-barrier diodes is carried out. The use a low-barrier diode in the detectors and power meters are shown.

articleTitle: Stability of work of continuous TWT with the power supply in a pulsed mode
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of combining continuous TWT with power supply at various ways of switching on are presented. The ways of solving problems associated with cathode voltage drop when the TWT focus electrode is switched on by high voltage modulator.

articleTitle: Slow-wave system for TWT terahertz range
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The principles of creation of TWT terahertz range are considered. Three electrodynamic models for slow-wave system (SWS) type comb to comb dielectric substrate in a rectangular screen have been obtained, and the calculated dispersion presented. The first model is based on the method of Green's functions and integral equations. The second model is based on the G.T. Markov formulas of excitation of a rectangular waveguide. The third model is based on the representation of SWS in the form of a microstrip line winding in the vertical plane and by using the dispersion equations based on the theory of long lines. The results for the dispersion and coupling resistance are presented.

articleTitle: Emission properties of titanium dioxide nanotube arrays
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Arrays of nanotubes or nanowires might be quite promising for auto-emission cathode applications while they possess high nanotube/nanowire density and a certain degree of ordering. In this work we studied the emission properties of TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanotube arrays obtained by electrochemical anodization. The nanotube arrays were characterized by scanning electron microscopy, atomic force microscopy and optical spectroscopy. Our results hint on a strong correlation between emission properties and geometry (tube density, tube diameter, roughness) of unfilled titania nanotubes.

articleTitle: Larmor orbit reducing in crossed fields at parametric resonance
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This report summarizes the results obtained in the papers relating to the amplification of high frequency signal in crossed electric and magnetic fields. In this report we demonstrated the possibility Larmor orbit reducing at parametric resonance. Studies were conduct to the radial case.

articleTitle: Quasi-stationary calculation of cutoff length of dominant wave of double- and four-ridged waveguides with layered dielectric filling of their central sections
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Approximate analytical expressions allowing carrying out quasi-stationary calculation of cutoff lengths of dominant waves of double- and four-ridged waveguides with layered dielectric filling of their central sections when interfaces are perpendicular to the force lines of electric field are derived with the help of the equivalent network method and using computer at the final stage of obtaining numerical results. Calculation results of normalized cutoff length of dominant mode of double-ridged waveguide obtained by using the method of equivalent networks and the finite element method for different values of geometrical sizes of layered dielectric filling of it central section are compared.

articleTitle: Parametric resonance and high-frequency oscillations generation in crossed fields
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this report, we show the ability to signal generation in systems with crossed electric and magnetic fields at parametric resonance. Authors have shown the behavior of electron cloud in next-gen generator. Estimated devices output characteristics based on the principles specified in this report were determined.

articleTitle: Metallization systems at pulse current influence. Phase transitions in the conditions of thermal shock
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Phase transitions of the first sort in aluminum metallization when passing through it single rectangular impulses of current with an amplitude up to 8.10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> A/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and lasting 100–1000 μs are considered. Processes of formation of the local melted-off zones, and also their subsequent migration in the course of current course are experimentally studied. The main mechanisms of movement of interphase border (at the expense of a thermal emission on limit of the section of firm and liquid phases) in the conditions of non-stationary heating of a metal film are revealed. Speeds of distribution of a liquid phase along a metallization path (∼ 25 m/s) are experimentally determined, and also the technique, allowing to count length of the melted-off zone after impulse passing is offered. Work is performed with support of grants of the Russian Fond Basic Research No 12-07-00620-a and No 14-07-0086914-a, as project No 2014/85 (a project code 2290).

articleTitle: Electrons trajectories analysis in crossed constant electric field and variable magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this report, we conduct analysis of electron properties in static electric field and time-depend magnetic induction. Authors have shown simulation trajectories of the electrons in different magnetic fields at different frequencies of the magnetic fields. Are shown conditions under which the electrons do not reach the anode.

articleTitle: A use of multi-port reflectometers in software defined radio systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the various design solutions of software-defined radio based on a multi-port reflectometer, including its use in modern wireless communication systems. The advantages of Substrate Integrated Waveguide before microstrip circuits for use in multi-port junctions discussed.

articleTitle: Synthesis of electron-optical forming systems with sheet electron beams
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A method of synthesis is developed, equations are derived and the results are obtained via this method for simulation of system that form intensity sheet electron beams with compression.

articleTitle: Impedance spectroscopy study of a response of potassium polytitanate based gas sensor
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Quasi-amorphous potassium polytitanates represent a new type of chemical compounds described by formula K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O•nTiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>•mH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O and are characterized by high specific surface. These materials are very promising as active materials in gas sensors. In this work, we studied the potassium polytitanates placed over SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Si/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> substrate equipped with multiple coplanar electrodes for the electrical response under various gases in mixture with air by impedance spectrometry.

articleTitle: Magnonic based microwave signal processing
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Results of investigation of the spin waves propagation in micro- and nanostructures based on ferrites and ferromagnetic films are discussed. Methods of excitation and detection of the spin waves of nanometers scale are considered. The physical phenomena arising under spin waves propagation in magnetic micro- and nanostructures and promising for microwave signal processing are discussed.

articleTitle: A new type of the microsized resonator with the asymmetric high-Q strip line for microwave devices with field-emission cathodes
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article describes a new dual mode two gaps resonator with the suspended ceramic substrate and the asymmetric strip lines. Using the asymmetric helical strip lines in resonator we can tunes it to anti-phase oscillation and to in-phase oscillation at the doubled frequency at the same time. On the basis of the 3-D modeling we found that such oscillatory systems can achieve the excitation of these modes with multiplicity of frequencies K = 2 with a good efficiency of interaction of electron beam with microwave fields.

articleTitle: Overlay longitudinal and transverse magnetic field components in the MPFS TWT
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the way, in which longitudinal and transverse magnetic field components adds to each other. Results of the measurement longitudinal and transverse magnetic fields are presented. Based on experiment authors determined regions in which components of the field are distributed.

articleTitle: Impedance design of a one screen coplanar line, placed at some distance from ferrite film surface
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: An excitation of magnetostatic surface waves (MSSW) with a one screen coplanar transmission line was considered for the case, when coplanar line is placed at some distance from the ferrite film surface. A technique is described for computing the impedance (both the reactance and radiation resistance) per unit length of a one screen coplanar transmission line. The dependence of this impedance on the spacing between the coplanar line and ferrite film has been studied for the case of magnetostatic surface waves. It has been found that smaller values of this spacing cause increase the frequency range of effective MSSW excitation. Narrow bandwidth (∼ 200 MHz centered 8,75 GHz) low insertion loss filters can be achieved by use shorted one screen coplanar transducers.

articleTitle: Study of feasibility to apply the graphene as a sensitive material for chemiresistor-type gas sensors
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this study we have considered chemo-resistive gas sensors based on graphene prepared by CVD. To investigate the gas sensing properties of graphene was proposed multielectrode chip design. Gas responses were obtained at room temperature of the chip.

articleTitle: Analitycal model of short-wave amplitron with more high level of output power
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A modification of amplitron with substantially larger cathode area in comparison with traditional devices cylindrical structure proposed. Approximate analytical estimates showing the possible benefits of the proposed modifications given.

articleTitle: Calculation of polarizability tensor for different types of single-wall carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Optical properties of open-ended armchair single-wall carbon nanotubes (SW-CNT) are studied by numerical simulations. The polarizability tenzor as main identifier of properties was analysed for different types of SW-CNT with various lengths. It is revealed that increase in nanotube length cause an increasing of polarizability degree that leads to essential change of SW-CNT optical properties.

articleTitle: Exchange spin waves exciting in yttrium-iron garnet films with surface microstructure
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Magnetostatic surface waves propagation in yttrium-iron garnet film with surface periodic array of grooves was studied. Effective excitation of exchange spin waves traveling along the film thickness was experimentally shown. Using micromagnetic modeling it was shown that internal magnetic field inside the film is nonuniform both in plane (periodically) and along the thickness at bias magnetic field directed perpendicularly to grooves' axis. The found nonuniformity is associated with good condition to excite exchange spin waves.

articleTitle: Waveguide selective devices on resonant diaphragms with complex aperture
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The problem of the electrodynamic analysis and synthesis of the waveguide bandpass filters on complex resonant diaphragms is solved. The aperture of diaphragm is a rectangular window with two L-shaped metal ridges. The dependences of transient characteristic of single diaphragm on frequency and aperture geometry are investigated, in particular the possibility of increase of attenuation level in a filters stop-band thanks to existence of full-reflection frequency (anti-resonance) is shown. The results of synthesis of three- and five-resonant filters with a pass-band of 10% are presented.

articleTitle: Obtaining high thermally conductive materials by the method of compaction of granulate
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This work contains results of investigation of obtaining high thermally conductive ceramics from commercial powders of aluminum nitride and yttrium oxide by the method of monoaxial compaction of granulate. The principal scheme of preparation is proposed and technological properties of granulate are defined. Compaction conditions for simple items to use as heat removal in microelectronics and power electrical engineering have been established. Investigations of thermophysical properties of obtained ceramics and its structure by the XRD and SEM methods have been carried out. Ceramics with thermal conductivity from 172 to 174 W/m·K has been obtained as result of these work.

articleTitle: A varactor diodes selection for the broadband microwave voltage controlled oscillator
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The subject of this paper is varactor diodes for ultra-broadband microwave VCO. Here is a description of a varactor diode model based on measured data. Presented varactor model can be used in various types of CAD for accurately design broadband microwave VCO and frequency-tuning circuits.

articleTitle: New approach to design of electron-optical system of powerful tethrodes with grid control
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The goal of this paper is to describe a new approach to design of electron-optical system of powerful tethrodes. Was presented the use of simulated electronic multi-beam flow this electron deceleration at anode. Using calculating o electron trajectory and experimental study was designed a cathode-grid assemble with control and acceleration grid. It was shown, that such approach it is possible to design a powerful tethrode higher output power and efficiency rather then by standard tethrode.

articleTitle: Application of waveguide electrodynamic systems to control of bulk single-crystal modifications of electro-optic Mach-Zehnder modulators
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article is devoted to solving the actual problem of the control laser beams with a radiated power of 10 watts and above in the microwave range. Shows the solution of this problem using bulk single crystal modification Mach-Zehnder modulators. Described the use as a control element waveguide electrodynamic structure of filter type.

articleTitle: A method of suppressing excitation of transverse higher wave types of multirow slow wave structures
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of studies of the transverse electric field distribution of basic and higher wave types of multirow interdigital slow wave structures with an arbitrary transverse position bounding planes are presented. A significant decrease of the higher modes amplitude is achieved by optimization of the transverse planes position.

articleTitle: Synthesis methodology of frequency convertor's voltage regulator for the kinematic buffering mode
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Kinematic buffering mode is intended to maintain operational condition of the frequency convertor - asynchronous motor system (FC-AM) at the short-term depressions of the supplying voltage. It is called so due to the fact that the direction of an active flux is changed into a reverse one at the voltage depression in the system. As a result, energy of the rotating masses (kinematic energy) is transformed into the electric one by the motor which is supplied through the convertor into the DC-unit and maintains charge (voltage) of the condenser at the constant level. At this, there is no energy exchange between the supplying network and the DC-unit.

articleTitle: Under-relaxation coefficient at modelling of generating-amplifying klystrons in self-consistent regime
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: For acceleration of calculating iterative process to establish the frequency in self-excited oscillator on double-gap cavity the under-relaxation quotient on the voltage is introduced. Optimal values of this quotient for minimum number of interations are determined.

articleTitle: Microwave resonator chambers for light source of low power
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the development and current state of light sources based on microwave discharge with low microwave power. The analysis of electrodynamic characteristics resonators of existing light sources are made. The possibility of using dielectric resonators to create efficient light sources has been shown. The prospects of using a cylindrical dielectric cavity on oscillations E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">011</inf> for resonators of light sources are discussed.

articleTitle: Vector control system of the static reactive power compensator
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In recent years to compensate reactive power in the electric mains and enhance stability of the electric supply the static reactive power compensators including STATCOM compensators are used [1]. This compensator is based on the autonomous voltage source invertor (AVSI) with pulse-width modulation. Its operation principle is based on the formation of the leading or lagging phase shift angle between current and voltage at the output of the AVISI connected with the supplying main phases.

articleTitle: Analysis of electron-optic systems for thin sheet beam forming
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The characteristics of electron-optic systems with plane and cylindrical cathodes and EOS with full accompaniment by magnetic field for thin sheet beam forming are discussed.

articleTitle: The use of asynchronous interaction of a running electromagnetic waves with electronic flow to improve the characteristics of the traveling wave tube
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: We discusses the mechanism of formation of local "failures" of output power TWT in the field of coincidence frequency of minus the first spatial harmonics (IPY) and one of the higher harmonics of the amplified signal. We proposed to use section of the slow-wave system, configured to the reduction mode signal IPY to minimize this effect.

articleTitle: Influence of the depth of fractal on the frequency dependence of inpedance in constructing models of composite materials
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this work simulated impedance composite equivalent circuit which has a similar hierarchical construction of a fractal. The influence of the depth of the fractal on the frequency dependence of the impedance.

articleTitle: The higher wave-guide mode of waves in helix slow wave structures of broadband TWTs
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Numerical calculations of the fundamental mode oscillations and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode oscillations for helix slow wave structures (SWS), applied in broadband TWTs were made. Calculations were performed for three versions of a construction with various type and quantity of vane on an envelope. Cutoff frequency H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode, electrodynamics characteristic and frequencies of π-type of the fundamental mode are calculated. Dependences of these frequencies on some geometrical sizes of elements of a SWS are gained.

articleTitle: The planar field emission array cathodes with carbon nanostructures in twt electron-optical systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of modeling the sub-millimeter TWT electron optical system with a low-voltage control based on the experimental data of the planar array cathode-gate structure with carbon nanostructures are performed in this work. It is shown that the cathode-gate structure including in the analyzed field emission electron gun manufacturing by lithographic processes and CVD technologies may provide the formation a long electron beams with current density of 15,5 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Investigation of microstrip broadband filters based on the resonator having strip conductor in the shape of an irregular meander
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Microstrip broadband filters based on the multimode resonator, having conductors in the shape of an irregular meander are investigated. The increase of the periods of the meander electromagnetically connected with several single-mode resonators allow considerably to improve frequency selective properties of filters.

articleTitle: Finite element simulation of surface acoustic waves excited in barium-strontium titanate films fabricated on magnesium oxide substrate by interdigital transducers
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper, we present study on surface acoustic waves excited in barium — strontium titanate films fabricated on magnesium oxide substrate by interdigital transducers. The surface acoustic waves propagation was simulated by using COMSOL Multiphysics™. The presence of bias, since the oscillations are not considered as sagittal polarized, is the principal difference between considered problem and standard problem that implemented in many finite element packages. The calculations of mechanic displacement and electric field potential for the first Eigen frequencies for different planes are shown. The methods of modeling in COMSOL Multiphysics™ software package are presented in this paper can be used for calculations of other systems that have different complex configuration.

articleTitle: Microbreakdowns in vacuum diode gaps with field-emission cathodes made of glass carbon
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper we perform experimental research results of micro breakdowns in diode gaps with the dimension less than 100 mkm. The main reason of micro breakdowns of gaps from 100mkm to 30 mkm is an explosion of nanoapexes on the cathode when the current density is about 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. In gaps less than 30 mkm the main initiator of breakdown is a warming-up and in some case also the anode material fusion in parts opposite the microapexes with power of electron flow with microapexes.

articleTitle: Modeling of planar vane slow wave structures for a travelig wave tube amplifier with sheet electron beam
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A fast and accurate code for calculation of eigenwaves in grating slow-wave structures (SWS) is developed. Such SWS are used in sheet-beam traveling wave tubes (TWTs) and backward-wave oscillators (BWOs) at sub-THz and THz frequencies. Results of numerical modeling of SWS for a G-band sheet-beam TWT are presented.
